sources.citation: Bouwman, Iris & Janny Holster. 1985. Kofei [Kofei Sauri-Sirami Wordlist]. UNCEN-SIL survey wordlist form 1/85, Kamp. Sauri-Sirami (Koweda atas), Desa Demba, Kec. Waren, Kab. Yapen-Waropen, 28-5-1985. Ms., 5 pp., 218 Indonesian prompts, c. 203 entries. SIL Language & Culture Archives item 69146.
sources.note: No prose at all; but the handwritten phonetic transcriptions mark primary stress with a raised vertical stroke on most items, e.g. p.1 'nosi (darah), 'usu (kulit), 'nuba/'nuga (daging), 'sanɔ (laut), 'dino / o'wu (abu tungku), o'bua (kepala), a'meb (membakar), ho'ai / ho'ei (satu); p.2 a'bimi (dua), 'tami / no'wia (hutan), 'zimi (hitam), 'aba^u (hujan), asi'moba (langit). Stress position varies between initial, second and final syllables across items, so the list is usable raw data for a stress analysis but contains no statement. Wordlist-only evidence.

sources.citation: Voorhoeve, C. L. 1975. Languages of Irian Jaya: Checklist. Preliminary classification, language maps, wordlists. Pacific Linguistics B-31. Canberra: ANU.
sources.note: Nothing. Checklist p. 10 lists Kofei (ref. 193, classification '?', map VIIIb); entry 193 on p. 60 (p. 63) reads: 'KOFEI, VIIIb.. Comments: The approximate location is given by Galis (1955); further data are not available. The language probably is a member of the East Geelvink Bay Family (DB), and could be a dialect of Baropasi (144).' No wordlist for Kofei in the wordlist section.
